cta.title: Stop Searching for Software. Get Schedules Done.
cta.description: Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices who already outsource physician scheduling to experts.

faq.answer: Physician scheduling software typically refers to self-service tools that require your team to learn, configure, and operate a platform. Scheduling Wizard takes a different approach entirely: it is a managed service where your program submits its rules and receives finished, optimized schedules delivered as Excel spreadsheets. There is no software for your team to learn or maintain. This done-for-you model eliminates the operator burden from chief residents and coordinators entirely.
faq.question: What is physician scheduling software and how does Scheduling Wizard differ?

faq.answer: We build the ACGME requirements in as the schedule is created rather than checking it afterward: the 80-hour weekly limit, minimum rest requirements, the 24-hour cap, and the specialty-specific Program Requirements for your program. We work from the requirements your program tells us apply, and we redraft when something needs to change. Groups and practices outside GME have no ACGME requirement, so for them we build to their own rules instead.
faq.question: How do you handle ACGME requirements for a residency or fellowship?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard delivers four types of schedules: Block and rotation schedules, Call schedules with fairness optimization, Clinic schedules, and Attending physician schedules. All schedule types are built together, so changes in one schedule automatically propagate across the others without manual cross-referencing.
faq.question: What types of physician schedules does Scheduling Wizard produce?

faq.answer: Yes. Many Scheduling Wizard clients continue using the platform they already have for day-to-day schedule access. Scheduling Wizard handles the schedule creation and optimization, delivering finished schedules as Excel files that your team can upload directly into your existing viewing platform. The two workflows are complementary, not mutually exclusive.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard work alongside the tools you already use?

faq.answer: Subspecialty-specific ACGME rules are built into the schedule itself. Rather than applying a generic compliance checklist, our team applies the specific duty hour rules, rotation requirements, and call restrictions relevant to your program's specialty. ACGME compliance is the most common question on sales calls, and it is designed to be answered with confidence for each specific subspecialty.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle subspecialty-specific ACGME scheduling rules?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard handles mid-year revisions as part of the managed service. When changes arise due to sick leave, parental leave, schedule swaps, or new rules, the affected portions of the schedule are re-optimized without disrupting the entire published schedule. Programs submit the updated rules and receive a revised schedule back, without needing to manually patch a spreadsheet or re-enter data into a software platform.

items.title: Done For You Schedule Delivery
items.description: Unlike self-service physician scheduling software, Scheduling Wizard handles the entire scheduling process. Submit your rules and receive finished Excel schedules, no software to operate, no learning curve, no annual retraining.

items.title: Compliance Built Into Every Schedule
items.description: We build each schedule to the rules that govern it. For a residency or fellowship that means the ACGME Common and specialty-specific Program Requirements: the 80-hour weekly limit, minimum rest, the 24-hour cap. For a provider group or practice it means yours: coverage minimums, call equity, contractual obligations, time off and requests, and multiple sites where a group has them.

items.title: Year-Long Rotation Schedules Optimized
items.description: Generates complete year-long block rotation schedules respecting PGY-level requirements, elective preferences, coverage minimums, and ACGME rotation mandates across even the most complex multi-track programs.

items.title: Fair Call Schedules Every Time
items.description: On-call schedules are algorithmically optimized to distribute call, weekend, and holiday burden equitably across residents while enforcing duty hour limits and post-call rules, eliminating fairness disputes.
